subject: Mutual Action Plan: PoC checklist & decision lighthouse
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@civichealth.co>
To: avery_johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-10-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: PoC next steps and MAP request

Thanks both — great call this morning. As mentioned on the call, CivicHealth wants to run a short PoC to validate inference latency on our aggregate patient documents and confirm data residency and retention controls.

High-level asks from our side:
- PoC target: 3 weeks, up to 50k tokens/day
- Security: SOC2 scope, retention policy documentation, and a sample redact workflow
- Commercial: ballpark pricing for hosted + a Dedicated option
- Decision owners: Sarah Mills (CFO) will own budget; procurement will own contract/terms; Liam (me) will run technical checks with the data team

Could you put together a Mutual Action Plan listing milestones, owners, and what evidence we need to hand to procurement/security? We'll push this through procurement once we have the MAP and SOC/retention artifacts.

Thanks — happy to hop on another 30-minute sync if helpful.

—Liam
Liam O'Connor
Director of Platform Engineering
CivicHealth
From: avery_johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@civichealth.co>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-10-01T12:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PoC next steps and MAP request

Thanks Liam — great to meet you. Quick post-call recap and proposed MAP (attached draft).

Recap (actionable):
- PoC scope: inference on 3 anonymized datasets you provide (clinical notes, intake forms, discharge summaries). Target: 3 weeks, max 50k tokens/day. Owner (Redwood): me (Avery). Owner (CivicHealth): Liam.
- Decision criteria: latency P95 < 250ms, mean per-token cost within X range (we'll provide options for Hosted vs Dedicated), security attestation (SOC2 evidence + retention config).
- Procurement path: compile MAP + SOC2 evidence -> Procurement review (Sarah Mills) -> Standard Redwood DPA + SOW -> procurement sign-off.

Attached: CivicHealth_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft) and SOC2-evidence-guide.pdf. The MAP has milestone rows; suggestions below. Please review and add owners that procurement requires.

Proposed MAP milestones (draft):
1) Kickoff & sample data delivery — due 2028-10-05 — owner: CivicHealth (Liam)
2) Ingress + anonymization check — due 2028-10-09 — owner: CivicHealth data team
3) Baseline inference run & perf report — due 2028-10-13 — owner: Redwood (Avery)
4) Security evidence submission (SOC2 artifacts, retention config) — due 2028-10-13 — owner: Redwood (Marissa)
5) Procurement review & initial commercial terms — due 2028-10-17 — owner: CivicHealth (Sarah)
6) Final PoC report & recommendation — due 2028-10-19 — owner: Redwood (Avery)

Next steps:
- Marissa, can you confirm the SOC2 packet and the minimal evidence set we should include for procurement?
- Liam, if you can confirm owners and add procurement email addresses we can ping them directly.

If the dates look tight we can extend the PoC by a week — wanted to propose a tight plan to surface blockers quickly. Happy to take this to a 30-minute MAP workshop if you prefer.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@civichealth.co>, avery_johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-10-02T08:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PoC next steps and MAP request

Adding the security checklist here — quick note on what procurement usually asks for so we can preempt back-and-forth.

Procurement/security asks (typical):
- SOC2 Type II report (redacted) + coverage dates
- Data flow diagram and retention policy document
- Encryption at rest + in transit descriptions and KMS options for Private installs
- Subprocessor list and subprocessors' country locations
- Sample Data Processing Agreement language (we include DPA + optional DPA addenda for EU/UK)

Suggested evidence bundle for initial procurement review (we'll attach in one packet):
- SOC2-evidence-guide.pdf (attached)
- Redacted SOC2 report (we'll redact customer names)
- Data flow diagram (redwood_shared_dfd_v2.png) — if you want, we can annotate it for CivicHealth's topology
- MAP_v1.xlsx (Avery's draft)

I'll drop a short packet draft by Friday 2028-10-05. Also tagging Kar thik to confirm if we should propose a Dedicated estimate in parallel or wait until baseline perf runs.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Security & Compliance (Redwood Inference)
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@civichealth.co>
To: avery_johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Mills <sarah.mills@civichealth.co>, procurement@civichealth.co
Date: 2028-10-03T10:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PoC next steps and MAP request

Thanks — this is helpful. I confirmed with Sarah: procurement wants the MAP + SOC2 packet before we schedule a contracting call. Also, Sarah asked that we highlight any fallbacks for data residency (e.g., Dedicated or Private deployment options).

We can commit to the sample data delivery on 2028-10-05. Procurement email is procurement@civichealth.co.

Can you add a short line in the MAP that specifies the evidence we will provide to procurement vs what we will provide after signature (e.g., full SOC2 vs redacted report)? That will help speed review.

I'll accept a 30-minute MAP workshop — how about Monday 2028-10-08 at 11:00am PT?

—Liam
From: avery_johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@civichealth.co>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, procurement@civichealth.co
Date: 2028-10-10T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PoC next steps and MAP request

Great — confirmed Monday 2028-10-08 11:00am PT for the MAP workshop (calendar invite sent).

Quick updates in prep for the workshop:
- I updated the MAP to call out "evidence required for procurement intake (redacted SOC2 + DF diagram + retention statement)" vs "evidence provided post-signature (full SOC2, optional Supplier Security Assessment)."
- Kar thik recommended we include both a Hosted estimate and a Dedicated starter configuration in the commercial appendix; we'll bring both to the workshop.
- Marissa will bring the SOC2 packet outline and a short note on encryption/KMS options.

Action items before Monday:
- Liam: deliver anonymized sample datasets by 2028-10-05 (owner: CivicHealth).
- Marissa: finalize procurement packet draft by 2028-10-05 (owner: Redwood).
- Karthik: prepare Dedicated cost sketch by 2028-10-06.

If anything changes on your side please flag here or drop a note in the MAP doc. Looking forward to the workshop.

Thanks,
Avery Johnson
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
